repos_data.description: 💾 Self-hosted online file converter. Supports 1000+ formats ⚙️

Open-source, self-hosted file-processing tool. Convert, compress, OCR, transcribe & run local AI across image, video, audio, PDF & documents, via UI, REST API & pipelines. Your files never leave your network.

MCP server for ChangeThisFile — file conversion across 1,000+ routes (image, video, audio, document, data, font, ebook, archive), plus translation, table extraction and exact-size compression. 25 free conversions/month without a key; free API key for more.
File tools for AI agents. Read and convert documents (DOCX, PDF, HWP, HWPX, EML), edit PDFs, resize, clean and cut out images, make QR codes. Runs locally, no upload.
Free MCP server to convert, compress & merge PDFs and 100+ file formats (Word, Excel, images, ebooks) from Claude, Cursor, VS Code & any AI agent. Powered by GuruPDF.
File conversion for AI agents: MCP server over the hushvert hosted API (office docs, PDF to Word, video, LLM-ready markdown)
MCP server for convertica.net: convert PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, HEIC and images from Claude, Cursor or any MCP client
